subject: Behavioral review — privacy & evidence preservation

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Behavioral review — privacy & evidence preservation

Monica / Karthik —

I received a concern yesterday afternoon alleging inappropriate comments in a small-team channel involving two ICs on Karthik's squad. I'm attaching a short summary from the reporter (Attachment: initial_complaint_summary.pdf). At this stage I want to make sure we preserve relevant evidence and handle communications carefully. Please take the following as immediate steps: 

- Karthik: preserve the Slack thread and any DMs related to this (do not delete or purge). Please export message IDs and add them to the HR drive folder.
- Monica: please confirm you have the checklist/controls for preservation and whether Legal should be looped immediately.
- All: do not discuss details outside this thread beyond "HR is looking into a personnel matter." We need to limit knowledge to those who need to know.

Proposed next steps: a quick triage call today (30 min) to confirm scope and who we interview, followed by private 1:1s. I'm available 1:30–3:00pm PT. If either of you need a different window, say so.

Thanks —

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
(Attachment: initial_complaint_summary.pdf)

Laura / Karthik —

Thanks for flagging this, Laura. I've started the case file (HR-789) and will own the intake and interview plan. Immediate actions we've taken / will take: 

1) Evidence preservation checklist applied — see attached (Attachment: evidence-preservation-checklist.docx). Please do not alter or comment on preserved messages.
2) I recommend we loop Legal for a confidentiality assessment and for any preservation letters. I'm going to reach out to Legal now; if they want to be cc'd on future emails I'll add them.
3) We should not reach out to the reporter or the subject outside of scheduled HR interviews. 

I can join the triage call at 1:30pm PT today. If Karthik can confirm the Slack channel and any relevant message timestamps prior to the call that will speed things up.

Monica Patel
